title: Automations: a scheduled run fires at its minute and shows on the page with its log

steps.title: Two automations made with the CLI; the runner on
cmux: clear; cmux automation create 'Every minute' --command 'echo checked disk' --every 1m >/dev/null && cmux automation create 'Morning brief' --prompt 'Summarize my open pull requests' --weekdays 09:00 >/dev/null; (cmux automation runner >"$TMPDIR/automation-runner.log" 2>&1 & r=$!; sleep 150; kill $r) >/dev/null 2>&1 & disown; sleep 1; cmux automation runner status
